stories.title: Circle launches Arc mainnet with USDC as native gas token
stories.summary: Circle has opened the mainnet for Arc, a new network that uses USDC as its native gas token instead of a separate protocol coin. The launch is Circle's push to make USDC the settlement layer for a chain it controls, rather than just an asset that runs on other networks.
stories.whyItMatters: A stablecoin issuer running its own settlement chain is a structural bet on USDC's future role, and it puts Circle in more direct competition with general-purpose chains.
whatToWatch: Early transaction volume and validator or node participation on Arc
Whether other issuers or apps build on Arc versus rival chains
questions: Who is actually running validators or sequencing on Arc, and how decentralized is it at launch?

sources.title: Circle opens Arc mainnet as it seeks an edge for USDC utility

stories.title: Ethereum's client diversity estimates diverge, muddying a key safety metric
stories.summary: Reports on Ethereum's client diversity, a measure of how evenly the network relies on different software clients, are now producing incompatible estimates depending on methodology. Client diversity matters because if one client dominates and has a bug, it can threaten the whole network.
stories.whyItMatters: Ethereum's resilience depends partly on no single client being a point of failure, so disagreement over how to even measure that is a governance and monitoring problem, not just a statistics quibble.
whatToWatch: Whether core developers converge on a standard measurement method
Any push for client teams or stakers to rebalance toward minority clients
questions: Which measurement is closer to reality, and does the discrepancy change the actual risk picture?

sources.title: Ethereum’s client diversity picture fractures under incompatible estimates

stories.title: ECB seeks online merchants for 2027 digital euro pilot
stories.summary: The European Central Bank has opened applications for online merchants to join a controlled pilot of the digital euro ahead of a planned 2027 rollout. The pilot is described as controlled, suggesting a limited scope rather than a broad public launch.
stories.whyItMatters: A digital euro would be a state-backed alternative to stablecoins and card networks for everyday payments, directly shaping the competitive landscape crypto payment projects operate in.
whatToWatch: Which merchants and countries are selected for the pilot
Further ECB timeline updates ahead of the 2027 target
questions: How will the digital euro be positioned against existing euro-denominated stablecoins?

stories.title: Anchorage expands institutional custody to Etherlink and tokenized uranium
stories.summary: Crypto custodian Anchorage Digital has added support for assets on the Etherlink network as well as tokenized uranium, broadening the range of institutional clients it can serve. The move extends Anchorage's custody business beyond mainstream tokens into more niche and real-world-asset categories.
stories.whyItMatters: Custody support for unusual tokenized assets like uranium signals institutional interest in real-world-asset tokenization is broadening beyond commodities like gold.
whatToWatch: Client uptake of the new Etherlink and tokenized uranium offerings
Whether other custodians follow with similar real-world-asset support
questions: Who is issuing the tokenized uranium, and what backs it physically?

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs post worst day since June after Clarity Act vote fails
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs suffered their worst single day since June, following a failed vote on the Clarity Act, a crypto market-structure bill. The setback in Congress appears to have driven a sharp negative reaction in ETF flows or pricing.
stories.whyItMatters: Spot ETFs are now a primary channel for institutional Bitcoin exposure, so regulatory setbacks that hit ETF flows are a direct read on how much legislative uncertainty weighs on institutional demand.
whatToWatch: Whether ETF outflows continue or reverse in coming days
Any rescheduled vote or amended version of the Clarity Act
questions: Was the reaction driven by the vote itself or by broader market conditions on the same day?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs Had Their Worst Day Since June Following Failed Clarity Act Vote

stories.title: Deutsche Bank still awaiting regulatory approval for crypto custody launch
stories.summary: Deutsche Bank is reportedly waiting on regulatory sign-off before it can launch institutional crypto custody services. No specific timeline for approval was given.
stories.whyItMatters: A major global bank entering crypto custody would be a signal of mainstream institutional acceptance, and the regulatory holdup shows how much banks still depend on supervisors' pace on digital assets.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of which regulator's approval is pending
An announced launch date once approval comes through
questions: Which specific licensing or supervisory hurdle is holding up the launch?

sources.title: Deutsche Bank awaits regulatory nod to launch institutional crypto custody solutions

stories.title: Bitcoin absorbs Fed rate hike as officials signal more tightening ahead
stories.summary: Bitcoin had been trading below $76,000 while markets awaited the Federal Reserve's rate decision, with analysts downplaying chances of a dovish surprise. The Fed went on to raise rates, and Bitcoin's price held up despite officials signaling further tightening could follow.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin's price has grown increasingly tied to Fed policy expectations, so a rate hike that doesn't trigger a selloff suggests the market had already priced in tighter conditions.
whatToWatch: Bitcoin's price trajectory in the days following the hike
Fed commentary or data hinting at the timing of any further tightening
questions: How much of Bitcoin's resilience reflects genuine demand versus the move already being priced in?

stories.title: Avalanche's Helicon upgrade slashes validator lockup from 14 days to 48 hours
stories.summary: Avalanche has rolled out its Helicon upgrade, cutting the time validators must wait to unlock their staked tokens from 14 days down to 48 hours. Shorter lockups make it faster for validators to exit or reallocate stake.
stories.whyItMatters: Faster unbonding lowers the opportunity cost of staking and could make Avalanche more attractive to validators and delegators compared with chains that impose longer lockups.
whatToWatch: Any change in validator participation or churn following the shorter lockup
Whether faster unbonding introduces new security or stability tradeoffs
questions: Does the shorter lockup weaken the economic deterrent against validator misbehavior?

sources.title: Avalanche’s Helicon upgrade cuts validator lockups from 14 days to 48 hours

stories.title: US lawmakers advance bill to codify Trump's Bitcoin reserve
stories.summary: US lawmakers have moved forward a bill that would lock the Trump administration's Bitcoin reserve into law. The move would give a strategic Bitcoin reserve, previously set up by executive action, a firmer legal foundation.
stories.whyItMatters: Codifying a national Bitcoin reserve in statute rather than executive order would make it far harder for a future administration to unwind, a significant marker of state-level crypto adoption.
whatToWatch: Further committee or floor votes needed to advance the bill
Details on reserve size, custody, and any acquisition plans
questions: What happens to the reserve if the bill stalls or a future Congress opposes it?

sources.title: US lawmakers advance bill to lock Trump’s Bitcoin reserve into law

stories.title: US House tax committee advances crypto tax overhaul in 38-5 vote
stories.summary: The US House tax committee voted 38-5 to advance a bill overhauling crypto tax rules. The lopsided vote suggests broad bipartisan support at the committee stage.
stories.whyItMatters: Clearer, more favorable crypto tax rules would remove a longstanding compliance headache for traders and businesses, making this a concrete step toward regulatory clarity beyond market-structure debates.
whatToWatch: Scheduling of a full House vote on the bill
Specific provisions in the overhaul, such as treatment of staking or small transactions
questions: What specific tax changes does the bill include, and when would they take effect?

sources.title: US House tax committee advances crypto tax overhaul in 38–5 vote

stories.title: Bitcoin's Coinbase Premium hits monthly low as Clarity Act vote squeezes US demand
stories.summary: The Coinbase Premium, a gauge of buying demand from US investors relative to other exchanges, fell to its lowest level in a month. The drop coincided with uncertainty around the pending Clarity Act vote in Congress.
stories.whyItMatters: A shrinking US buying premium suggests American investors were pulling back ahead of a key regulatory decision, a useful real-time gauge of how legislative risk affects demand.
whatToWatch: Whether the Coinbase Premium recovers or falls further after the vote outcome
US-specific trading volume trends in the days ahead
questions: How much of the premium drop reflects US-specific caution versus a broader global pullback?

sources.title: Bitcoin Coinbase Premium hits monthly low as CLARITY Act vote squeezes US demand

stories.title: Tonkeeper rebrands to Keeper, adds Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron support
stories.summary: Tonkeeper, a wallet built primarily for the TON network, has rebranded as Keeper and expanded to support Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron. The rebrand accompanies the wallet's shift from a single-chain to a multi-chain product.
stories.whyItMatters: A TON-focused wallet broadening to major chains reflects the wider trend of wallets consolidating around multi-chain support rather than staying tied to one ecosystem.
whatToWatch: User adoption of the expanded multi-chain wallet
Whether further chains get added over time
questions: Does the expansion change how the wallet handles security or custody across the different chains?

sources.title: Tonkeeper Becomes Keeper as Wallet Adds Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron
